gen-gf-croissant-one-fs-rowan: Swollen curves that taper to a hairline thread give Croissant One its commanding, spread-out personality. And Rowan, a friendly serif with generous openings, softens that showiness into something literary and good for a few lines.
gen-gf-croissant-one-lora: Lora reads bookish and welcoming, with only a modest gap between stems and hairlines, so it isn't built for sprawling paragraphs. Croissant One's swollen, needle-fine drama is the real draw.
gen-gf-crushed-fs-rowan: Gaping lowercase curves run together in Crushed, forming one dark, tight band that wants short company rather than long paragraphs. Rowan, literary and friendly, loosens things with open curves and lighter strokes.
gen-gf-dekko-archivo: Dekko's c opens like a pair of calipers, giving its casual handwriting a friendly lean that works well over a few lines. Archivo's commanding x-height gives it a grounded, editorial footing.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-asap: Friendly and casual, Dekko brings a calipers-style c and a tall, brush-pen belly to the top of the page. Asap's open arcs keep its text readable, though not across endless paragraphs.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-epilogue: Dekko's c opens like a pair of calipers, all casual handwriting. Epilogue's wire-like monoline skeleton gives the loose handwriting a stricter partner, made for brief bursts of reading.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-erode: Dignified and editorial, this text serif settles into a tall middle band with shallow ascenders, best taken in modest helpings. Erode lets Dekko's casual, calipers-like c do the chatting up top while its own weight ebbs and flows.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-fira-sans: Casual and friendly, Dekko wears its handwriting openly, from the caliper-like c to the squat, brush-pen belly. Fira Sans is the steady foil: no thick-thin shift, big x-height, made for brief reading.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-public-sans: Hefty and trustworthy, the lowercase here has broad open counters, which makes a few lines feel dependable. Public Sans stands firm under Dekko's loose, hand-drawn heading, a sturdy counterweight to its casual lean.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-supreme: Dekko's c swings open like a pair of calipers, and its tall, brush-pen belly keeps the handwriting friendly. Supreme, crisp sans with a heavy middle strip, stays open as the text piles up but is happiest in moderation.
